
### Install
Download **AnnePro-VERSION.zip**, unzip it and move **AnnePro.app** to Applications. The app isn't notarized, so the first time macOS blocks it: on macOS 15 and later go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**; on macOS 13–14 right-click the app and choose **Open**. See the [README](https://github.com/thtjst/annepro-macos#install) for details.

Works with the original Anne Pro (micro-USB) only, not the Anne Pro 2.
